metadata.description: Collection of meta-skills for creating and customizing skills

plugins.name: mcp-skill-creator
plugins.description: Create workflow-optimized skills from MCP servers. Transform MCP tools into personalized skills with progressive disclosure, parallel execution, and embedded user preferences. Based on Anthropic's MCP + Code Execution best practices.

plugins.name: skill-customizer
plugins.description: Fork and iteratively customize existing skills based on your preferences and workflows. Perfect for personalizing skills to match your output format preferences, company standards, or domain-specific requirements.
